title: Miss Universe Brazil 2026: Photoshoot, Runway Show, and Preparation for the Final
seoTitle: Miss Universe Brazil 2026: Photoshoot, Runway, Prep
subtitle: Marcella Kozinski Shines in Photos, on the Runway, and in Spanish Interviews Ahead of Miss Universe in Puerto Rico
excerpt: Marcella Kozinski, Miss Universe Brazil 2026, stars in a photoshoot, walks for PatBO at New York Fashion Week, and practices Spanish interviews.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: R7, CNN Brasil, CLAUDIA - o sentido feminino
contentHtml:
Marcella Kozinski, crowned Miss Universe Brazil 2026, has been in the spotlight recently after releasing a new photoshoot, walking for the PatBO brand in New York, and intensifying her preparation for the Miss Universe final, scheduled for November 24 in Puerto Rico.

Photoshoot Celebrating the Crown

The pageant's official profile released images of the winner in a fully sparkling dress, combining the classic sash with the crown that consecrated her. In the post, the page highlighted Marcella's personality, attitude, and growing confidence. Fans praised the Paraná native's beauty and poise, stating that the crown had found its perfect owner.

Walking for PatBO at New York Fashion Week

On Tuesday (15), Marcella walked the runway for PatBO during New York Fashion Week, presenting the Spring/Summer 2027 collection titled “Splendid Brazil.” The collection featured a mood board of flowers, butterflies, and gardens, with hand-embroidered details, transparencies, and volumes that celebrate the identity of Brazilian fashion. The model commented that walking in New York with a national brand reinforces the message of a creative and sophisticated Brazil that she wishes to bring to Miss Universe.

Mastering Spanish as a Strategy

During her stay in New York, Marcella gave interviews in Spanish, a language she masters. She explained that speaking Spanish impresses the Latin American audience, which is predominant in Miss Universe coverage and in the host country of the final, Puerto Rico. Using the language facilitates direct contact with the local press, the regional audience, and other Latin American candidates, who form the most numerous and engaged bloc in the competition.

Partnership with Lingerie Brand Hope

In the same edition of New York Fashion Week, PatBO used shapewear from the Hope lingerie brand as a base for the collection's looks. According to Hope's Marketing Director, Flávia Vagen, the shapewear supports, molds, and influences the drape of the clothes, offering comfort and security so that each creation is enhanced.

Preparation Roadmap for the Final

Marcella's international schedule includes language refinement, image commitments, photographic productions, and interviews with specialized press. These activities aim to strengthen the Brazilian representative's presence on the world stage and consolidate the image of a creative, sophisticated, and excellent Brazil.

With information from R7, CNN Brasil, CLAUDIA - o sentido feminino.
